context_requirements: Expression of the relevant lipase target in the cell line
Availability of a lipid substrate whose hydrolysis is rate-limiting for a transcriptional response
For FASN inhibition, dependence on de novo fatty acid synthesis rather than exogenous lipids
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Coordinate induction of canonical lipogenesis genes such as FASN, ACLY, ACACA, SCD, HMGCR, or INSIG1
Changes in lipid-metabolism landmark genes including LIPA, LYPLA1, PLA2G15, or ABHD4
Evidence of ER stress or unfolded protein response after treatment
